contenders.handicapper_notes: Top pick. Philip D Amato turf wheelhouse specialty. Ran a sparkling 97 speed figure in US debut over this turf course on July 18 when leading at mid-stretch before finishing third by just over two lengths. Now fully acclimated to Del Mar, picks up Hector Berrios, and draws perfectly inside the Post 8 Durante penalty threshold.

Extremely consistent 3YO colt hitting the board in 4 of 5 career outings. Overcame a rank, troubled trip to finish third in an 8-furlong turf MSW here last month. Draws ideally in Post 4 to save ground into the tight first turn.

Possesses genuine tactical early foot. Ran a sharp 90 speed figure when second over a mile on turf at Santa Anita, splitting quality runners. Mark Glatt barn clicks with route runners and he should secure a clean stalking spot from Gate 6.

Danger horse. Michael McCarthy trainee paired with Kazushi Kimura. Posted a strong 95 speed figure two starts back over the Del Mar turf with a solid late rally. Benefits from ground-saving Post 3 geometry.

Talented Bob Baffert runner making turf debut after back-to-back runner-up dirt efforts. Must overcome the harsh -5 point Del Mar Durante turf geometry penalty for drawing Post 10 into the short run to the first turn.

First start since reported as gelding for Philip D Amato with Juan Hernandez aboard. Possesses talent but is severely compromised by drawing the outermost Post 12, triggering the mandatory -5 point Durante geometry penalty.
